history.summary: UOL-developed large condo (99yr from 2014) on Prince Charles Crescent, D3/Bukit Merah-Alexandra. 1BR at $1,974 psf ($999k) screens cheap with the deepest data in this batch (218 appreciation txns, 19 cohort txns), and D3 is a strong RCR rental belt.
history.rating_rationale: This is the most data-credible 'cheap' in the batch: age_adj_premium -16.7% with 218 appreciation txns and 19 cohort txns (not a thin-data quirk). Recent 12-month transactions span $1,859-$2,699 psf (avg $2,158); a small 1BR at $1,974 psf is at/below that average despite small units normally commanding the HIGHEST psf — so the asking looks genuinely under-market. UOL build quality is well regarded and the Alexandra/Redhill corridor is a deep rental market (CBD/Mapletree/one-north tenants), supporting RCR forward (~+3.5%). Trailing 2.98% CAGR is non-predictive but the value signal (the robust forward driver per v3.4) is the real edge here. Held to Buy (not Strong Buy) because I lack a same-size 1BR comp to confirm the discount, leasehold from 2014 means ~87yrs left, and D3 is RCR not OCR (the best forward region).
red_flags: No verified same-size 1BR resale comp found; the discount is inferred from a pooled $1,859-$2,699 range that mixes in larger units
99-yr leasehold from 2014 (~87 yrs remaining) — mild decay drag over a long hold
1BR is investor-grade product; D3 1BR rental pool is solid but exit competes with abundant small units
catalysts: Deep, trusted developer (UOL) and large full-facility project — strong resale liquidity
Alexandra/Redhill/one-north employment + Greater Southern Waterfront long-term redevelopment underpins D3 demand
Walkable to Redhill/Tiong Bahru amenities; RCR rental belt with steady tenant demand
